mantra.line: The pull and load scripts already run, and round 2 loaded 627 more images on 10/11.
Each board is one label. Its top posts are that label's examples. The matcher is the one open build.
Chief's corrections feed back as new examples, so the engine's accuracy climbs with use.

items.t: "how we used Reddit as a reference for body parts to get the … pictures that I scanned before … we reverse engineer it … pull … top … images per board and then reference them under the … body part … the AI engine uses that as a way to then feed into coding in everything else that I already pulled … I'll be also adding updates to that library … it can automate the accuracy"
"getting those images from Reddit … for the girls"
The scripts `ref_pull.py` and `ref_load.py` pull and load the images. Claude built both on 10/6.
The script `embed_pass.py` makes image embeddings. Each label's examples become a reference point.
BOLO 44 gave the DARKROOM its tag rail and zero-shot tagging.
Chief ruled "all recs" on 10/6. Taxonomy ruling 7 is lifted: private labeled examples only, never reposted.
By 10/7 the pull held 18 boards and about 6,270 images on `Q:un\_REDDIT\`. The DARKROOM has straight and gay modes.
Six girl boards came back thin at the 1,000 floor, with 1 to 68 images each. The second archive, Arctic Shift, answered 422 "slow down".
The re-pull finished on 10/9. The six girl boards went from 162 images to 1,198. One board stayed dead at 4 images.
Re-pull round 2 landed on 10/11. Five boards loaded 627 images. One board came back empty and one stayed dead. Claude recommends dropping both.

paragraphs.main_effort: Build the board-as-label matcher, so each board becomes a label and its top posts become that label's examples.

phases.t: **Pull and load built.** Claude wrote `ref_pull.py` and `ref_load.py`. Six boards pulled first, 300 posts each at 1,000+.
**First wave landed.** The pull held 18 boards and about 6,270 images on `Q:un\_REDDIT\`, with straight and gay modes.
**Tier-2 pass re-tagged the corpus** with the V set in.
**Girl lane re-pull.** Six girl boards re-pulled at a 250 floor (provisional). The six boards went from 162 images to 1,198. 1,036 loaded into the DARKROOM.
**Re-pull round 2.** The script `run_repull2.sh` lowered the floors on the thin boards. Five boards loaded 627 new images.
**Board-as-label matcher.** Claude builds the first step on go: map the original boards to the tag rail's labels.
**Body-part board list.** Claude drafts the list and checks each board against the archive.
**Video step.** The video-heavy boards need a video step before they can load.
